Our Commitment To You
We’re proud of the diverse and inclusive environment we have at Sophos, and we’re committed to ensuring equality of opportunity.   We believe that diversity, combined with excellence, builds a better Sophos, so we encourage applicants who can contribute to the diversity of our team.  All applicants will be treated in a fair and equal manner and in accordance with the law regardless of gender, sex, gender reassignment, marital status, race, religion or belief, color, age, military veteran status, disability, pregnancy, maternity or sexual orientation.  We want to give you every opportunity to show us your best self, so if there are any adjustments we could make to the recruitment and selection process to support you, please let us know. 
 
Data Protection
If you choose to explore an opportunity, and subsequently share your CV or other personal details with Sophos, these details will be held by Sophos for 12 months in accordance with our Privacy Policy and used by our recruitment team to contact you regarding this or other relevant opportunities at Sophos.  If you would like Sophos to delete or update your details at any time, please follow the steps set out in the Privacy Policy describing your individual rights.  For more information on Sophos’ data protection practices, please consult our Privacy Policy Cybersecurity as a Service Delivered | Sophos

descriptionPlain:
About Us
Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
 
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
 
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com.


Role Summary
We are looking for a senior product manager to accelerate adoption and growth of Sophos Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), a market-leading protection, detection, and response solution for endpoints and servers. In this role, you will own product strategy, technical product development, and go-to-market execution for Sophos EDR. You will turn market signals, customer needs, threat research, telemetry, and business goals into clear product priorities that help customers hunt, investigate, and respond to advanced threats with speed and confidence.
This is a significant opportunity for an AI-native product manager to apply modern product management skills to expand adoption, improve customer outcomes, and strengthen Sophos EDR’s leadership in the market. Success requires a product leader who can work deeply with engineering and research teams while also building the positioning, packaging, launch strategy, and field enablement needed to grow a proven, market-leading EDR solution.

Role Summary

We are looking for a senior product manager to accelerate adoption and growth of Sophos Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), a market-leading protection, detection, and response solution for endpoints and servers. In this role, you will own product strategy, technical product development, and go-to-market execution for Sophos EDR. You will turn market signals, customer needs, threat research, telemetry, and business goals into clear product priorities that help customers hunt, investigate, and respond to advanced threats with speed and confidence.

This is a significant opportunity for an AI-native product manager to apply modern product management skills to expand adoption, improve customer outcomes, and strengthen Sophos EDR’s leadership in the market. lists.content:
• Be the voice of the customer by understanding how IT admins, security analysts, managed service providers, CISOs, and managed security service providers detect, investigate, hunt, respond, report, and prove security outcomes across endpoint and server environments.
  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and measurable business outcomes for Sophos EDR within the Sophos Endpoint portfolio.
  • Define the product direction for endpoint detection, threat hunting, investigation, response, case workflows, telemetry, reporting, and upgrade paths into XDR and MDR.
  • Partner with Sophos X-Ops, Sophos MDR Ops, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ship EDR capabilities that serve both IT generalists and security analysts.
  • Use AI-first product management practices to improve discovery, decision-making, requirements definition, launch readiness, customer insight analysis, and product storytelling.
  • Define and prioritize AI-powered EDR experiences such as natural language search, case summaries, command analysis, investigation guidance, analyst assistance, and response recommendations.
  • Translate customer research, endpoint telemetry, competitive intelligence, revenue opportunities, and field feedback into product requirements that engineering teams can execute.
  • Build go-to-market plans, launch narratives, buyer personas, partner enablement, pricing inputs, and adoption motions that grow Sophos EDR revenue, usage, and market leadership.
  • Represent Sophos EDR in customer councils, executive briefings, partner conversations, competitive reviews, analyst discussions, and internal strategy forums.

• 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in cybersecurity, endpoint security, EDR, XDR, MDR, security operations, IT operations, or adjacent technical product areas.
  • Demonstrated success taking technical products from strategy through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint detection and response workflows, including detections, investigations, threat hunting, response actions, telemetry, reporting, and analyst productivity.
  • AI-first product management skills, including practical experience using AI to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prioritization, requirements development, launch planning, customer insight analysis, and product operations.
  • Strong fluency across Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint platforms for endpoint security outcomes.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering, threat research, security operations, product marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams to define product-market fit and execute go-to-market plans.
  • An open mind, strong curiosity, humility, urgency, and sound judgment, with a proven ability to use data, customer insight, and stakeholder input to make clear product decisions.
  • Clear executive communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, customer value, commercial impact, roadmap decisions, and launch priorities in simple language.
